ev.q: This report describes four fatal cases among children with community-acquired MRSA
MRSA isolates from these four cases were susceptible to all antimicrobial agents tested except beta-lactams
This report describes four fatal cases among children with community-acquired MRSA

methods_quotes.q: Sma I was the restriction enzyme used for PFGE.
Isolates from all four cases had the mec A gene by PCR assay at MDH.
